name: suggest_sources
description: Return 1-5 authoritative sources related to the blog post topic. Every URL must be copied verbatim from a web search result on this call — never reconstructed, edited, or recalled from memory. Returning fewer sources, or an empty list, is correct when search surfaced nothing solid; padding the list with guessed URLs is not.

title.description: The page's actual title, as shown in the search result

url.description: Full URL, copied character-for-character from a web search result. Do not edit version numbers, slugs, hashes, or paths.

summary.description: 1-2 sentences on what this source covers and why it is relevant to this post

sources.description: 0-5 sources, preferring stable homes (official docs, GitHub, PyPI, arXiv) over aggregators like Medium or DataCamp that rot and block automated readers
